summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the escape format ESC ] 0 ; title BEL and the Control.title classmethod with a docstring. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, returning True only when is_terminal and writing the control. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one legacy dispatch branch calling term.set_title with the title. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR #2200. Tests added (none modified): test_console.py::test_set_window_title (non-Windows), test_control.py::test_control_title, test_windows_renderer.py::test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only, mocked). Not run: tests and Black formatting, per instructions; lines were kept under 88 characters by inspection.
